mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} ORDER BY s.SEM_ID DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_ID
mapper.sql: SELECT a.LEC_ANN_ID AS noticeId, a.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode, a.LEC_ANN_TITLE AS title, a.LEC_ANN_CONTENT AS content, mb.MEMBER_NAME AS author, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ANN_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDate, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ANN_REG_DATE, 'MM.DD') AS listDate FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT a JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE pr ON pr.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER mb ON mb.MEMBER_ID = pr.MEMBER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT a.LEC_ANN_ID AS noticeId, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT a WHERE a.LEC_ANN_ID IN #{id} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY a.LEC_ANN_ID, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_REG_DATE, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID

SELECT a.LEC_ANN_ID AS noticeId, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT a WHERE a.LEC_ANN_ID = #{noticeId} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY a.LEC_ANN_ATT_REG_DATE, a.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID

SELECT att.LEC_ANN_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME AS trnFileName, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT att JOIN LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT a ON a.LEC_ANN_ID = att.LEC_ANN_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID WHERE att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID = #{attachmentId} AND att.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}

INSERT INTO LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT ( LEC_ANN_ATT_ID, LEC_ANN_ID, LEC_ANN_ATT_REG_DATE, LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME, LEC_ANN_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME, LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_URL, LEC_ANN_ATT_FIL_SIZE, LEC_ANN_ATT_EXT_TYPE, ATT_VAL_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT.NEXTVAL, #{noticeId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{orgFileName}, #{trnFileName}, #{orgUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{extType}, 'ACT' )
